::: {.obsidian-audit-report}
:::

State the audit objective in one paragraph. Name the process
audited, the period, and the standards or policies applied.

# Findings

Record each finding with its severity. Use one sub section per
finding. Name the evidence and the process requirement it
contravenes.

# Nonconformities

List the nonconformities with their classification: major or minor.
For each, state what failed and the standard breached.

# Corrective actions

For each nonconformity, state the corrective action, the owner, and
the due date. Use a table.

# Conclusion

State the overall opinion on the process. Confirm the scope limits
and any reliance placed on management assurance.
